title: Sales & Inventory
subtitle: Merge sales, revenue and stock across every shop by your own SKU code, get restock alerts and spot best sellers. Read-only sync from TikTok Shop Seller Center.
noShop: No shops yet. Click "Add shop" and paste the login cookies exported from Seller Center.
loginExpired: {shop}: the Seller Center login has expired. Click "Paste cookies to log in", or "Log in to Seller Center" to log in directly.
firstSyncHint: The first sync reads the last {orders} days of orders and {history} days of sales history. It takes a few minutes.

todo.title: To do today
todo.out: {code} is sold out; {units} sold in the last 7 days
todo.hot: {code} is a best seller: {units} sold in 7 days ({growth})
todo.unmapped: {n} products have no SKU code, so their sales are not merged

table.empty: No data yet. Click "Sync data" to read from Seller Center.

daily.hint: Today and days covered by synced orders are counted from orders (unpaid and cancelled excluded); older days come from Data Compass.

quantityHint.count: What you have on hand now; later sales are deducted automatically
quantityHint.adjust: Use a negative number to reduce, e.g. -3

stock.ledgerEmpty: No records yet. Do one "Count" per SKU; stock then goes down with sales automatically.
stock.howItWorks: SKUs you have never counted show the Seller Center stock. Counted SKUs use: count + stock in ± adjustments − units sold since.

mapping.intro: Map each shop's products to your own SKU code. Sales and stock with the same code are merged. Products with a seller SKU in Seller Center are mapped automatically.
mapping.empty: Products appear here after a sync.

settings.title: Restock rules
settings.leadDaysHint: Days from ordering stock until it can be sold
settings.safetyDaysHint: Extra days of stock to avoid running out
settings.historyDays: Days of sales history to read
settings.orderWindowDays: Days of orders on first sync
settings.formula: Daily average = units in the last 14 days ÷ 14. Reorder point = daily average × (lead time + safety days). Suggested restock = daily average × (lead time + safety days + days to last) − current stock.
settings.tagRule: Hot: top 20% by 7-day units and up 50%+ vs the previous 7 days. Rising: up 30%+. Declining: down 30%+. Slow: in stock but no sales for 14 days.

detail.title: {code} details
detail.name: Display name
detail.needCode: Give it a code in "SKU mapping" first to record stock.

errors.SELLER_INVENTORY_DATE_IN_FUTURE: The date cannot be after today

sharedLogin: Shop logins are managed in one place under "Shops" in the sidebar and shared with Creator Hub; updating anywhere updates all.
